plainTranslation: A's growth meets B's identity. The trine lets them flow together easily.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from project-authored synastry matrix material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
summaryDeep:
This person may bring out your confidence and help you see opportunities more clearly.

Their support tends to arrive in ways that feel easy to receive. You may leave conversations with them feeling more certain of yourself than when you started, or find that doubts loosen their grip when this person is around. They have a way of reflecting back your capabilities and helping you reconnect with a sense of direction when you have lost sight of it.

When this works, being around this person can make it easier to keep moving toward what matters to you. They have a way of meeting your doubts with confidence, helping you remember why you started when you lose sight of the larger picture. Their belief in your capacity can steady you during difficult moments and make challenges feel more manageable, not because they solve them for you, but because they remind you that you are capable of meeting them.

This kind of support can be incredibly valuable. Success often depends on having people in your corner who see your potential, encourage your development, and challenge you to keep moving toward what matters most.

Support only matters if you do something with it. This person may believe in you, encourage you, and remind you of what is possible, but their faith cannot build your life for you. The gift here is confidence. The work is turning that confidence into action.

Let this person's belief in you push you forward. Their encouragement can build your confidence, but it only matters if you act on it. This connection works best when hope is backed by effort and growth is supported by consistent action.
